rows.description: PCI Express vertical SMT card-edge socket, {N} contacts, 1.00 mm pitch (Amphenol 10165968)
rows.note: Amphenol drawing 10165968 rev A (PCI Express Gen 6, SMT type), datasheets/connector-card-edge/amphenol/10165968c.pdf, sheet 3 'Recommended PCB layout, pad type' (the catalog ssio_pcie_gen6.pdf has no land pattern; this sibling drawing of the same 10165968 base number is used). Origin: x = centre of the A1..last-A pad extent, y = connector centre line; sheet 1 shows the housing symmetric about the pads (3.00 each end: housing D = L0 + 6.0 = 25/39/56/89, layout table col D) and 7.40 deep (section A-A). Pads 0.53 x 2.00, rows at y = -3.60 (side A, pins A1..) and +3.60 (side B) from the centre line (printed 3.60 to the pad centre), pitch 1.00, A1..A11 / B1..B11 then the 3.00 key (A11 to A12 = 1.65 + 1.35; extra gap 2.00), then (N/2 - 11) more pads (table dim J = 6/20/37/70 spaces from A12). Pins 1..N/2 = A1..A(N/2), the rest B1..B(N/2). Pad length 2.00 +/-0.05 (sheet 3). Hold-down pads: two 3.00 x 5.00 rectangles (pin 0) 3.00 outside the end pads (DIM H = L0 + 9.0 outer to outer: rect centre = end pad +/- (4.50 - 1.50)). Two 1.2 mm positioning holes (non-plated assumed, printed 2X dia 1.2 +/-0.05): left 1.65 right of A11 (10.00 + 1.65 from A1), right 1.80 from the last A pad (DIM K = hole to hole = J + 3.15); on the print the right hole sits in a notch (about 0.95 mm clear radius, open to the pad's left edge) cut out of the right 3.00 x 5.00 pad; the library does not allow a hole inside a pad, so the right pad is drawn as three pin-0 rectangles that leave a rectangular clearance (x from the pad's left edge to hole + 0.90, y within +/-0.95 of the hole): top and bottom 3.00 x 1.55 and a 1.80 x 1.90 strip at the pad's right end (approximation of the notch, not printed as rectangles). The 3.84 x (J + 0.70) region between the rows (solder-mask recommendation for the ground bar) is not copper and is not drawn. L0 = first-to-last pad centre of side A = N/2 - 1 + 2.00.

rows.description: PCI Express straddle-mount card-edge socket, {N} contacts, 1.00 mm pitch (Amphenol 10173133)
rows.note: Amphenol drawing 10173133 rev A (PCI Express 6.0 assembly, straddle mount type), datasheets/connector-card-edge/amphenol/10173133.pdf, sheet 2 'Recommended PCB layout' (pad sizes and lengths), sheet 1 (housing and mounting ears), table col DIM D = 92.60. BOARD EDGE: the connector straddles the PCB edge; the board edge is the line y = +5.00 (the footprint's body, 10.00 deep from sheet 1 mid view '10.00' above the board edge line, occupies y -5.00 .. +5.00 outside the board; the board lies at y > 5.00). Origin x = centre of the A1..A82 extent (housing DIM B = 89.00 = L0 + 6.0), y = housing centre. Pads 0.60 wide, their inner ends 3.20 from the board edge (y = 8.20); signal pads 1.60 long (y 6.60..8.20) and the ground pads listed in the print's note 1 (A12,A15,A18,A20,A23,A24,A27,A28,A31,A34,A37,A38,A41,A42,A45,A46,A49,A51,A54,A55,A58,A59,A62,A63,A66,A67,A70,A71,A74,A75,A78,A79,A82 and B13,B16,B18,B21,B22,B25,B26,B29,B32,B35,B36,B39,B40,B43,B44,B47,B49,B52,B53,B56,B57,B60,B61,B64,B65,B68,B69,B72,B73,B76,B77,B80) 2.50 long (y 5.70..8.20, 0.70 from the edge): the long pads are the 1.60 pad plus a touching 0.90 x 0.60 pad of the same pin (y 5.70..6.60). Pitch 1.00; A1..A11, key 3.00 (A11 to A12 = 1.50 + 1.50 about the key centre line), then A12..A82 (70 spaces, table N). A pads are on the footprint's own face (pins 1..82 = A1..A82), B pads (pins 83..164 = B1..B82) are on the far face ('opposite') at the same x and y: the print shows the two faces as two views labelled PIN A1 / PIN B1 with B1 under A1 but does not say which face is top (assumed A on the part's face). Two non-plated (assumed, M2 screw holes) 2.30 +/-0.05 holes 2.50 from the board edge (y = 7.50) at 16.30 from the key centre line, i.e. 4.80 outside A1 / A82 (DIM D = hole to hole = 92.60 = L0 + 2 x 4.80). The hatched keep-out areas and the cap are not drawn. L0 = 83.00.

rows.description: PCI Express Cool Edge 6.0 vertical SMT card-edge socket with latch, {N} contacts, 1.00 mm pitch (Amphenol 10177636)
rows.note: Amphenol drawing 10177636 rev 3 (PCIe Cool Edge 6.0, SMT vertical, assembly - latch; PRELIMINARY), datasheets/connector-card-edge/amphenol/10177636.pdf, sheet 2 'Recommended PCB layout' (catalog ssio_pcie_gen6.pdf has no land pattern). Origin x = centre of the A1..A82 pad extent; y = centre line between the rows. Pads 0.55 +/-0.03 x 1.20 +/-0.05, pitch 1.00, rows 6.00 outer / 3.60 inner apart => centres at y = -2.40 (A, pins 1..82) and +2.40 (B, pins 83..164) (1.20 + 3.60 = 4.80 between centres); A1..A11, key (A11 to A12 = 3.00: extra gap 2.00; mating sheet 3 '2X 3.00'), A12..A82 (70 spaces). Holes (non-plated assumed; the print gives no plating): dia 1.95 +/-0.05 at 2.00 left of A1 and dia 1.65 +/-0.05 at 2.00 right of A82 (hole to hole 2 + 83 + 2 = 87.00 printed), both 1.50 below the centre line (y = +1.50). Two 2.90 x 3.80 rectangular pads (pin 0), their inner edges 1.55 +/-0.05 from the hole centres: centres 5.00 outside the end pads (1.55 + 1.45 + 2.00). The latch keep-out (19.00 x 15.00) is not copper and is not drawn. Housing: sheet 1 plan view gives housing 87.00 +/-0.10 long (side view) and about 5.80 deep (ref); drawn as L0 + 5.25 = 88.25 x 5.80 centred on the pads (the housing is not exactly centred on the pad extent: about 0.3 mm approximate, printed housing end positions are not dimensioned).

rows.description: M.2 (M key) Gen5 reverse-mount right-angle card-edge socket, 67 contacts, 0.50 mm pitch (Amphenol 10181068, 1.88 mm)
rows.note: Amphenol drawing 10181068 rev 3 (M.2 Gen5 RVS connector, M key 1.88H), datasheets/connector-card-edge/amphenol/10181068.pdf, sheet 2 'Recommended PCB layout' (viewed from the top of the board; pin 1 is at the right). Contacts are numbered in M.2 order skipping the key: contact c = M.2 pin c for c <= 58, contact 59..67 = M.2 pins 67..75; odd pins on one row (side 0, 34 pads, pitch 0.50, 29 pads pin 1..57 then key then pins 67..75: 57 to 67 = 2.50, extra gap 2.00; span 18.50 printed), even pins on the other row (33 pads, pin 2..58, 68..74: 58 to 68 = 2.50; span 18.00 printed); pin n sits 0.25 left of pin n-1 (pin 1 to pin 2 offset 0.25 printed), so both rows are centred on the connector centre line (9.25 and 9.00 from it, printed). Pads 0.30 +/-0.03 x 1.10 +/-0.03. Rows 2.40 apart: with the two locating holes at y_h, the even row is y_h - 2.05, the odd row y_h + 0.35 (printed 2.05 and 0.35). Origin: x = connector centre line, y = midpoint of the two pad rows (y_h - 0.85); the housing's position relative to the pads is not dimensioned on the print, so the outline (23.80 x 8.75 overall, sheet 1 plan view) is only centred there. Holes (non-plated assumed): dia 1.20 +/-0.05 at 11.00 left (y_h = +0.85) and dia 1.70 +/-0.05 at 11.00 right. Two 1.20 x 2.75 +/-0.05 solder-tab pads (pin 0, surface mount as printed: no hole is dimensioned) at x = +/-11.385 (printed 11.385 from the centre line), 4.97 below y_h (y = +5.82). The PCB cut-out edge is 1.80 below y_h (y = +2.65); the printed 5.40 and the 4.20/6.50 standoff circle are not drawn.

rows.description: M.2 (M key) Gen5 2.3 mm right-angle card-edge socket, 67 contacts, 0.50 mm pitch (Amphenol 10185344, M.2-1A)
rows.note: Amphenol drawing 10185344 rev 3 (M.2 Gen5 2.3H KEY_M 1A), datasheets/connector-card-edge/amphenol/10185344c.pdf, sheet 3 (PCB layout, top view, pin 1 at the left). Contacts numbered in M.2 order skipping the key: contact c = M.2 pin c for c <= 58, contacts 59..67 = pins 67..75. Odd pins (side 0, 34 pads, upper row on the print): pin 1 .. pin 57 (14.00), 57 to 67 = 2.50 (extra gap 2.00), 67 to 75 = 2.00, total 18.50, 9.25 each side of the centre line (printed). Even pins (33 pads, lower row): pin 2 .. pin 58 (14.00), 58 to 68 = 2.50, 68 to 74 = 1.50, total 18.00, 9.00 from the centre line (printed). Pads 0.30 +/-0.03 x 1.55 +/-0.03, pitch 0.50. Rows: holes at y_h; the odd pads span y_h - 6.05 .. y_h - 4.50 (centre y_h - 5.275) and the even pads y_h + 1.50 .. y_h + 3.05 (centre y_h + 2.275) (printed 6.05, 4.50, 3.05; 1.55 pad length). Origin: x = connector centre line, y = the midpoint of the rows (y_h - 1.50), so odd row y = -3.775, even row +3.775, holes y = +1.50. The housing outline is not dimensioned relative to the pads: body 21.85 (printed overall, sheet 1) x 6.30 (measured on the plan view, not printed), centred on the origin. Non-plated holes (printed NPTH): dia 1.15 +/-0.05 at 10.00 left of the centre line, dia 1.65 +/-0.05 at 10.00 right. Solder tabs pins 76 / 77 (printed 'PTH', 1.20 +/-0.03 x 2.75 +/-0.03, centres 10.35 from the centre line, 4.50 above y_h): a plated slot hole 1.20 x 2.75; the print gives no pad size, so the copper is assumed 1.40 x 2.95 (0.10 ring), pin 0. Sheets 1-2 give the connector outline (21.85 x ...) and the card (20.15, 22.00 wide).
